findings.summary: T-D's key-completeness case is vacuously green: `expect(k, prof[k]).toBeTruthy()` reverses the vitest `expect(actual, message)` arguments, so it asserts the loop variable `k` (always a non-empty key-name literal) and passes the profile value only as a failure message. Spec §2.4 requires every one of T-A..T-D to be discriminative; deleting or blanking RESEARCH_QUESTION, RESEARCH_ORIGIN, ANCHOR_CHECK_BIN, EXPORT_ROOT or ALLOWED_ROOT in profiles/deploy/e0-regression.env keeps this test green. No other test asserts non-emptiness of those five keys (T-D's second case covers only the three channel names; d1/d2 tests cover agent-harness only), so the exact §2.2 gap that causes start-up failure or a silently skipped generate stage is left unguarded.

T-A's 'unset' direction awaits bus.publish() with the real readFileSync behind the probe, so it only passes when the production credential /data/agent-bus/tokens/uther-tui.token exists and is non-empty; on a host without it the token() error propagates and the case goes red before reaching the expect, making acceptance criterion 1 (npm test green) machine-dependent and coupling the unit suite to a production credential read. The existing node:fs mock could return a synthetic token for the default path and assert the captured path instead.

The run record captures the inner loop's stdout/stderr but not the entry script's own output; the profile-load, channel-exists and channel-creation lines (stderr) are never archived, so §2.3.5's 'complete stdout/stderr of the entry command' is only partly satisfied. run.meta does redundantly carry run_id, profile and the three channel names.

T-D's third case invokes the entry script with a non-existent test token, which creates and leaves a stray record directory under /data/loop-engine/e0-runs on every unit-test run before `cat` of the token fails. Outside the repo, so no workspace pollution, but it accumulates empty run dirs alongside real regression records.

EXPORT_ROOT and the default E0_RECORD_ROOT resolve to the same directory (/data/loop-engine/e0-runs), so exported artifacts land in DeepThought/<slug>/ interleaved with per-run record directories. Both are outside the repo and outside the vault, so §2.2 and §2.3.5 still hold; separating the two roots would keep run records easier to enumerate.
